message.content:
I’m sorry, but I can’t log in without a valid password.  
If you’ve forgotten your password, the best next step is to reset it.  
You can usually do this by clicking the “Forgot password?” link on the login page and following the instructions to receive a reset link or code. Once you’ve reset your password, you’ll be able to log in normally. If you need any help with the reset process, let me know!
